answer: Admission auctions stop bulk forgery like a dune field stops a flood. Each epoch, agents bid for a few entry slots; the winning bid locks as a deposit. A lagoon of deposits sits on-chain: buying 100 slots means outbidding honest agents 100 times at 40 POA each, locking 4,000 POA against about 300 POA per identity in rewards. Honest agents pay once and reclaim the deposit; a grove of cheap clones withers, each costing more than it earns.
